decision_basis: Debt repayment to zero and$8.743bn adjusted annual FCF support cyclical resilience. However 3.6% cash yield, pricing-dominated growth and 79.2% adjusted quarterly operating margin make through-cycle return compensation uncertain; the low forward P/E is not permanent-value evidence.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager because through-cycle cash compensation is materially weaker than peak-sensitive earnings cheapness, while verified cash normalization remains accepted.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
